job.name: vk2_pin
job.style: A finished, premium, modern graphic for the VK social-network community of «ИИАВАТАР» — a service that turns any text into a video with an AI presenter (digital avatar), for business: ads, staff training, Reels/short clips, online lessons, videos in 30+ languages. Brand style: deep graphite #111311 background, vivid orange #F3531B accent with subtle orange glow, white text, bold modern condensed grotesque headlines, clean and minimal, high contrast, 2026 tech-product aesthetic. Any people are photorealistic, diverse, friendly professionals (NOT celebrities). Perfectly spelled Russian text is REQUIRED and is the ONLY text: headline «Любое видео без съёмок», four small labels under the screens «Реклама» «Обучение» «Reels» «30+ языков», orange badge «от 1 000 ₽ за минуту», small bottom line «Пишите в сообщения». No other words, no phone numbers, no links, no watermarks, no real app UI or logos.
job.style_qa: графика в графитово-оранжевом стиле, понятно что это сервис видео с ИИ-ведущим из текста, надписи без ошибок: headline «Любое видео без съёмок», four small labels under the screens «Реклама» «Обучение» «Reels» «30+ языков», orange badge «от 1 000 ₽ за минуту», small bottom line «Пишите в сообщения»; лишнего текста, ссылок и телефонов нет
job.prompt: Vertical poster, keep everything inside the central 86% of the HEIGHT: headline at the top; a 2×2 grid of four screens, each with a DIFFERENT AI presenter in a different business context (ad for a product, office training with a slide, vertical phone clip with hearts, presenter with flags of several countries), each screen with its label under it; orange price badge below; small line at the bottom.
